topic: Context: Ground truth under .opencode/skills/system-spec-kit/: templates/{core/,addons/,packet-types/,spec-kit-docs.json,EXTENSION-GUIDE.md,README.md}; runtime/cli/spec/create.sh(--with-lazy-addons,--phase); runtime/cli/templates/inline-gate-renderer.ts; runtime/lib/templates/level-contract-resolver.ts; runtime/cli/rules/{check-ac-closure,check-ac-coverage,check-files}.sh; native ANCHORS_VALID/SPEC_DOC_SUFFICIENCY checks in runtime/lib/validation/; references/structure/{folder-structure,phase-definitions}.md; references/templates/*.md; references/workflows/goal-set-string-playbook.md; SKILL.md; root README.md. These may disagree with each other on scope, composition, and enforcement. || Role: Documentation-implementation auditor: treat the manifest, create.sh, and the validator rules as ground truth, and README.md, SKILL.md, and references/ prose as claims to test against them, never the reverse. || Action: rotate one angle per pass, evidence only from the cited files: (1) manifest owner/creationTrigger/absenceBehavior per document vs what create.sh writes per level and flag; (2) README.md/SKILL.md labeling resource-map.md, timeline.md, roadmap.md, goal.md, before-after.md, decision-record.md as core or addon, vs the manifest and create.sh; (3) --with-lazy-addons vs the manifest addon set, and whether any doc states timeline/roadmap are lazy while resource-map/goal stay explicit-option; (4) acceptance-criteria.md: which rules read it (AC_CLOSURE, AC_COVERAGE), what each enforces, and whether Level 2/3 packets under specs/ carry Met rows with evidence or leave it a scaffold; (5) checklist.md vs acceptance-criteria.md vs the tasks.md verification checklist as three completion-gate surfaces; which one the validator and completion exposer reads; (6) the goal addon: its render path through inline-gate-renderer.ts, whether any command offers it, and whether phase parents in specs/ honor the nested-goal binding; (7) template version fields vs SPECKIT_TEMPLATE_SOURCE headers for drift between manifest and shipped files; (8) which templates or surfaces could merge or drop without losing a validated capability. || Format: one finding per entry: path:line, the claim, what the manifest/script/rule does, severity (P0 broken, P1 wrong-or-unused, P2 cosmetic), one-line recommendation: remove, merge, fix, or document. Cite every claim as [SOURCE: path:line]. || Target: a decision-ready findings ledger for spec-kit maintainers on whether to fix, merge, or document each surface. Non-goals: no file edits, no new templates, no prose-style review. Verify every angle above with cited evidence before concluding.

detachedFanout.note: This detached lineage process is the executor for EVERY iteration; no nested CLI/agent/subprocess dispatch. step_resolve_artifact_root satisfied by config.fanout_lineage_artifact_dir override: artifact_dir bound directly, resolveArtifactRoot node command not run.

reducer.note: Detached fan-out: reducer function (registry/dashboard/strategy machine-owned sections) is performed inline by the lineage executor after each iteration, deriving strictly from the iteration delta records.

statePaths.note: Lineage-confined: all state lives at artifactDir root (flat), not under the packet research/ dir, because the lineage write surface is the lineage directory itself.
